treatments.minimal: Assess whether the supplied source excerpt supports, contradicts, or does not decide the claim. Return ONLY JSON with exactly these keys: label ('supported', 'contradicted', or 'insufficient'), evidence_span (an exact contiguous substring of the excerpt, or empty if none is decisive), and reason (one concise sentence). Do not add any other keys.

run_order: random.Random(20261122).shuffle(cases) separately per model and treatment; treatment ordering alternating per model; development first, holdout after development metrics frozen
success_test: Scientific lab prompt is beneficial on these constructed cases only if holdout improves at least one error or complete family without increasing false contradictions or missing explicit contradictions; not a claim of population performance.
constraints: No model output sees family, split, gold label or rationale; no model downloads/network; no new CI/merge gate; no model prompt tuning based on holdout.
limits: Single-operator constructed synthetic excerpts and subjective gold rationale; evidence switching measures logical excerpt responsiveness, not source authenticity or independent human scientific analysis.
